qualified_at_declared_scale_when: All 3 attempts meet every pass bar. Fewer is recorded as k of 3 and is not qualified; nothing is re-run to replace a failure
invalid_attempt_when: An infrastructure fault outside the roles (worker crash, studio restart, plan outage, browser missing) stops the attempt before a verdict. It is recorded with its cause, and each attempt may be replaced at most once

coverage_note: The checker reports what it saw while a case ran plus 1 s after its last step. A request scheduled later than that is not seen; the QA sandbox has no network either way, and the claim is no outside request was seen during the frozen cases.
